usage: sot-validator ups-health [-h] [--snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                [--output OUTPUT_FILE] [--snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE]
                                [--min-runtime-minutes MIN_RUNTIME_MINUTES]
                                [--critical-runtime-minutes CRITICAL_RUNTIME_MINUTES]
                                [--max-temp-celsius MAX_TEMP_CELSIUS]
                                [--critical-temp-celsius CRITICAL_TEMP_CELSIUS]
                                [--max-load-pct MAX_LOAD_PCT]
                                [--critical-load-pct CRITICAL_LOAD_PCT]
                                [--evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME]
                                [--site-ids SITE_IDS [SITE_IDS ...]] [--all-sites]
                                [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE] [--rate-limit RATE_LIMIT] [--no-resume]
                                [--fixtures] [--num-sites NUM_SITES] [--fixture-path FIXTURE_PATH]
                                [--sql-dump SQL_DUMP] [--sqlite-path SQLITE_PATH]
                                [--csv-dir CSV_DIR] [--json-export JSON_EXPORT]
                                [--scrape-url SCRAPE_URL]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --snapshot-dir SNAPSHOT_DIR
                        Directory containing extracted site snapshots.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to write ups_health_report.json (default: ./reports).
  --output, --output-file OUTPUT_FILE
                        Optional explicit output path for ups_health_report.json.
  --snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE
                        Path to SNMP PowerNet-MIB discovery fixture JSON file.
  --min-runtime-minutes MIN_RUNTIME_MINUTES
                        Minimum battery runtime remaining in minutes before warning (default:
                        15.0).
  --critical-runtime-minutes CRITICAL_RUNTIME_MINUTES
                        Critical battery runtime remaining in minutes (default: 5.0).
  --max-temp-celsius MAX_TEMP_CELSIUS
                        Maximum battery temperature in Celsius before thermal warning (default:
                        40.0).
  --critical-temp-celsius CRITICAL_TEMP_CELSIUS
                        Critical battery temperature in Celsius (default: 50.0).
  --max-load-pct MAX_LOAD_PCT
                        Maximum output load percentage before overload warning (default: 80.0).
  --critical-load-pct CRITICAL_LOAD_PCT
                        Critical output load percentage (default: 95.0).
  --evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME
                        Optional reference ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.
  --site-ids SITE_IDS [SITE_IDS ...]
                        Target site IDs (comma-separated or space-separated, e.g.
                        site-001,site-002).
  --all-sites           Process all available sites.
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                        Number of sites per extraction batch (default: 10).
  --rate-limit RATE_LIMIT
                        Polite delay in seconds between per-site requests (default: 0.0).
  --no-resume           Disable checkpoint resume and re-extract all target sites.
  --fixtures            Use deterministic built-in FixtureSoTClient inventory.
  --num-sites NUM_SITES
                        Number of fixture sites to generate when --fixtures is set (default: 3).
  --fixture-path FIXTURE_PATH
                        Path to a JSON fixture file for FixtureSoTClient.
  --sql-dump SQL_DUMP   Path to a read-only SQL dump file (.sql).
  --sqlite-path SQLITE_PATH
                        Path to a read-only SQLite database export.
  --csv-dir CSV_DIR     Path to a directory containing SoT CSV export tables.
  --json-export JSON_EXPORT
                        Path to a JSON export file of SoT tables or sites.
  --scrape-url SCRAPE_URL
                        Base URL for read-only GET HTML scraping of the legacy SoT.
